name: Entangling Shredder Trap

stealth.details: (expert) to notice the pressure plates under the rugs

disable: DC 24 Thievery check (expert) on the pressure plates.

items.name: Entangling Ropes
items.text:
Trigger Two creatures enter the hallway or end their turn in the hallway

---

Effect The trap makes a barbed rope Strike against the triggering creatures. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.

items.name: Grasping Ropes
items.text:
The ropes whip around the limbs of the target. The target must attempt a DC 25 Reflex save save.

---
Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is Off-Guard until it cuts the ropes or Escapes.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also Immobilized.

text: Dozens of ropes embedded with steel barbs spring out from the walls when at least two creatures step on the rugs.
